entries.title: Ask HN: What are some examples of successful single-person businesses?

entries.title: Ask HN: Google Doc email virus?
entries.author: eof
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Google Doc email virus?
entries.excerpt: We just received multiple "google doc shares" that seemed sketchy and were not sent by the claimed sender. They came from different companies that have no connection to each other, I assume others are seeing them too right about now. Anyone know whats up?
entries.guide_zh: 多家公司收到冒名 Google 文档共享邀请，读者询问是否是邮件病毒。

entries.title: Ask HN: For those programming 10+ years, what do you wish you knew 4 years in?
entries.author: dhruvkar
entries.current_title: Ask HN: For those programming 10+ years, what do you wish you knew 4 years in?
entries.excerpt: I've been programming for ~3 years now, first just on the side and now full-time. My learning has been in stops and starts. Now I can feel the cumulative learning paying off. I'm also realizing there's SO much more to learn. What advice do you have for programmers just hitting their stride?
